name: 3,4,5-trimethoxyamphetamine
summary: 3,4,5-Trimethoxyamphetamine (TMA, TMA-1, or 3,4,5-TMA), also known as α-methylmescaline (3C-mescaline or 3C-M) or mescalamphetamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families. It is one of the trimethoxyamphetamine (TMA) series of positional isomers. The drug is notable in being the amphetamine (α-methylated) analogue of mescaline (3,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine).

pharmacology.text: TMA is also a very low-potency serotonin releasing agent (SRA), with an EC50 value of 16,000 nM.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist
